title: Loved getting to sit in on a rehearsal for @a kidman carol which star...
transcript: Just got to sit in on a rehearsal for A Kidman Carol, which is the new Christmas Carol parody that takes place on the Eve of Oscar night, when Cate Blanchett is visited by the ghost of three Nicole Kidmans. That indescribable feeling when the lights begin to dim and we go somewhere we've never been before. Oh, Nicole. Nicole Kidman. Somehow heartbreak feels good in a place like this. What? What are you doing here? The show itself is written by Kevin Zak, who also wrote Ginger Twinsies. It is as ridiculous as the premise alone sounds, and I laughed a ton already just in the rehearsal room. It was really cool to get to see the rehearsal process, because while they're rehearsing the show, they don't have any of the design elements. Sort of a rough outline of the set, especially for a show like A Kidman Carol. There's gonna be a lot of video elements in it that I cannot wait to see in the final version. And so much of the rehearsal process is them just trying to get these roles into their bodies and going through the motions So that when you put all of the costume pieces and the set together and the lighting and the sound design, by the time they get all of that together on the stage for the final product, they'll have the roles lived into their body. And so it's just about trying to find the beats. Of how they're going to interact with this material. And because it's a new show, they're also rewriting it. So even today, they had new pages that they were rehearsing for the first time. A Kidman Carol starts performances at New World Stages on November 16th, playing through December 30th. And I cannot wait to see the finished product.
